answer: Each agent registers in meadow, a Merkle state tree, and submits a TPM/SGX enclave quote with zero-knowledge attestation to saffron, the consensus contract; garden, a VDF verification circuit, binds quote freshness to sequential work. Forging identities requires compromising enclave hardware or provisioning distinct silicon continuously, while quadratic bonding curves O(N^2) price registrations and irreversible collateral slashing penalizes equivocation.
